edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the from argument of transfer
msg.sender is the spender used for the allowance subtraction in transferFrom
constructor credits _rTotal to the deployer from _msgSender
_msgSender returns msg.sender
transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before allowance bookkeeping
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
allowance subtraction via sub(amount) can revert under SafeMath semantics
from is compared to owner(), pair and router and read in the bots check
to drives cooldown, pair detection and bots checks
amount is bounded by _maxTxAmount and used in fee math
transferFrom amount flows into the token transfer math
bots[from] and bots[to] gate execution of the transfer
cooldown[to] is written with block.timestamp plus 30 seconds and read as a gate
cooldown and max transaction checks depend on miner-influenced block.timestamp
require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) enforces the transaction size limit
pair address equality checks determine buy/sell fee direction
router address is filtered out in the transfer direction checks
_feeAddr1 is overwritten with 2 at the start of every transfer
_feeAddr2 is set to 8 or 10 depending on the trade direction
swapEnabled conditionally activates the automatic swap block
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap
balanceOf derives the token balance from _rOwned
balanceOf result is stored in the contractTokenBalance local
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth
external swap is executed inside _transfer before token balances are updated by _tokenTransfer
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call while holding the contract token balance
tokenAmount flows directly into the external router swap call
uniswapV2Router is used for WETH lookup and the swap
swapTokensForEth approves the router for tokenAmount
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around the external call as a weak guard
sendETHToFee is invoked after the swap and before the caller balances are written
address(this).balance is forwarded to sendETHToFee
ETH is pushed out to fee wallets using address.transfer inside the transfer flow
amount.div(2) is sent to each fee wallet
_feeAddrWallet1 receives the first half of the ETH
_feeAddrWallet2 receives the second half of the ETH
a malicious pair/router invoked during the swap can re-enter _transfer before _rOwned is updated
_tokenTransfer runs only after the fee/swap block
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard
_transferStandard calls _getValues for the amount breakdown
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee
_rOwned[sender].sub(rAmount) and _rOwned[recipient].add(rTransferAmount) depend on SafeMath bounds
_rOwned[address(this)].add(rTeam) accumulation depends on multiplication overflow checks
_rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rFee) permanently shrinks the reflection supply
_tFeeTotal.add(tFee) accumulates fee totals
_getValues computes the current reflection rate
_getRate reads supplies from _getCurrentSupply
rate is rSupply.div(tSupply) over _rTotal, a division that can revert if supply is zero
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to derive the rate
onlyOwner openTrading stores the hardcoded router address
addLiquidityETH external payable call executes before swapEnabled, _maxTxAmount and tradingOpen are persisted
openTrading calls factory().createPair on an externally supplied factory address
openTrading grants the pair an unlimited router allowance
the created pair address is stored in uniswapV2Pair
tradingOpen is set true as the final initialization step
swapEnabled is set true inside openTrading
_maxTxAmount is reset to the full supply inside openTrading
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline
owner() is used as the liquidity recipient and gates the call
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling owner-only functions
onlyOwner setBots writes arbitrary addresses into the blacklist mapping
bots_ array elements become blacklist keys and can freeze arbitrary holders
delBot clears the blacklist flag for a supplied address
notbot parameter is used as the blacklist key in delBot
onlyOwner removeStrictTxLimit resets the transaction cap
onlyOwner setCooldownEnabled toggles the timestamp-based cooldown
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] without a zero-address-free amount check
approve forwards to _approve with msg.sender as owner
constructor sets _owner to the deployer enabling all onlyOwner powers
constructor mints the full reflection supply to the deployer
constructor exempts owner, contract and both fee wallets from fees
constructor hardcodes the fee wallets to a single EOA address
constructor executes at deployment time gating the initial supply distribution
